description: This file defines the ExponentialBestFit class, which extends the BestFit class and provides methods for performing exponential regression analysis, including calculating the equation of the best-fit exponential curve, its slope, intercept, and related values.

classes.name: ExponentialBestFit
classes.description: Class for calculating exponential best-fit regression, including obtaining the equation, slope, intercept, and intersect values.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y value for a given X based on the exponential model.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X value for a given Y based on the exponential model.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the exponential regression equation.

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope of the exponential curve, optionally rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: getIntersect
methods.description: Returns the intersection point where the curve intersects Y=0, optionally rounded to specified decimal places.

methods.name: exponentialRegression
methods.description: Performs the exponential regression calculation using provided Y and X data arrays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ExponentialBestFit object and performs regression if no error occurred.
